description: Production mensuelle de Biométhane par région (depuis 2014) is a dataset listed in GRDF open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution operator, published or maintained by GRDF. Ce jeu de données permet de visualiser l'évolution de la production de Biométhane en MWh et le nombre de sites de production, par mois et par maille géographique. La maille géographique est la maille région. Ces données sont publiées dans le respect des règles relatives à la protection des Informations Commercialement Sensibles (ICS). Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Production et stockage. Its keywords are production, gaz renouvelable, gaz, territoires, région. The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-grdf-open-data-portal.
